title: VTGE HAND CRAFTED ROCK NATURAL STONE DESK CLOCK Battery Operated
descriptionText: The VTGE hand crafted rock natural stone desk clock is a vintage-inspired piece that adds a unique touch to any room. Made with mixed materials including stone, plastic, and metal, this oval-shaped clock features a gold-brown color and a polished epoxy stone finish. Powered by a quartz movement, this battery-operated clock displays the time in an analog format, making it a functional and stylish addition to your decor. Perfect for those who appreciate Americana style and enjoy collecting decorative items with a twist of natural elements.
